note: Two separate gates, both non-waivable (D18). Satisfying one never satisfies the other (INV-R1). The Phase 0 completion gate does not require D13 or D14; both are conditions of the Phase 1A entry gate (FE-8), and each is satisfied only by an approved resolution with content and version, never by the presence of a row.

gates.title: Phase 0 completion gate
gates.evaluates: Whether PR-0 and PR-A through PR-I are complete.
excluded_conditions: Real integrations are not required; they remain closed.
A completed Phase 1A specification is not required.
D13 does not block this gate.
D14 does not block this gate.

conditions.text: PR-0 and PR-A through PR-I are merged to origin/main in that order.
All 47 invariants have at least one passing conformance test and at least one negative test each.
The specification validator passes: no invariant lacks a family, four owners or a named test; the census equals the manifest length.
Every Round 1 to Round 5 finding and every carried debt item is closed against its invariant, or explicitly deferred by a recorded decision.
Every medium and low raised in any slice carries a recorded FIX, ACCEPT or DEFER. None is undispositioned.
The migration chain upgrades a populated v1 database through v2 to v7 with all rows, references and provenance preserved, verified at each step.
No slice carries an open blocker or high, judged as the tuple aggregate of R4.

Every effect-journal entry has a definite truth. No entry is in a non-terminal state, in particular none is UNKNOWN_PENDING_RECONCILIATION; and no entry is ABANDONED_BY_DECISION, quarantined, or carrying effect_truth = UNKNOWN. An abandoned entry satisfies this condition only after its named remediation has produced a definite outcome.
The documentation-conformance check passes: no documented guarantee lacks a test, no documented command fails when run as written.
Auto-merge, self-hosting and every real integration remain disabled, verified by test.
The deployment note records the D3 single authority domain constraint.

gates.title: Phase 1A entry gate
gates.evaluates: Whether real provider implementation may begin.

conditions.text: The Phase 0 completion gate is satisfied.

D13 carries a resolution with outcome APPROVED, a content reference and a content version, and the consequence of that outcome holds: if D13 says medium and low debt blocks Phase 1A, then no such debt remains open.
D14 carries a resolution with outcome APPROVED naming the exact specification slice that holds the provider lifecycle, and its content version.
The provider lifecycle specification is approved in writing at exactly the location and version D14's resolution names.

gates.prohibition: Until every condition holds, no real adapter implementation may begin. The existence of a decision row is not a decision: a condition naming a decision is satisfied only by an APPROVED resolution with a content reference and a content version, whose consequence has been evaluated. The absence of a decision is not permission (INV-A1).
